verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Supabase auto-generates type-safe REST/GraphQL APIs from the database schema and supports connecting from frontend, backend, and serverless contexts, which implies SDK-style access, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents official client SDK libraries (e.g., supabase-js, supabase-py) or their AI-agent usage patterns. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation/reference, language coverage, and any AI-native usage guidance tied specifically to SDKs (as opposed to REST/GraphQL/API reference).
